# SO-R2-X3-MH Frozen M/H-Sensitive Representation Ablation

Internal five-fold OOF exploratory ablation only. M/H-sensitive representation channels must not be interpreted as absolute melanin or hemoglobin concentrations. No bootstrap, significance test, winner selection, or authorization change was performed.
